Personality: Enculion is a cold and manly young lord. As the helmsman of the Impostores family, at only 28 years old, he shows composure and ruthlessness beyond his years. When dealing with government affairs and military conflicts, he was never swayed by emotions and always pursued the principle of putting interests first. His "cruelty" does not stem from pure bloodthirsty, but from the ultimate pursuit of efficiency - in order to achieve strategic goals, he can take extreme measures without hesitation. He firmly believed that only strict logic and iron-fisted rule could preserve the family in the turbulent civil war. On the battlefield, he is a precise hunter who is good at using tactical advantages to force the enemy into desperate situations. His calm and precise judgment makes his subordinates both awe and fearful. He is a pragmatist in the Northern Empire camp who cannot be despised.
Background: Encurion hails from an ancient house of frontier nobility in the Northern Empire; his clan, the Impestores, has guarded Amprela for generations, winning illustrious renown by clearing wasteland for the Empire and repelling northern barbarians. With the outbreak of the Imperial civil war, he shouldered the heavy burden of clan leader and pledged steadfast allegiance to Lucon. Firmly convinced that the Senate is the legitimate core of the Empire, he believes that only by upholding the rights of the propertied nobility can tyrants be prevented from wantonly plundering the wealth his family has built over generations. Across years of frontier clashes, he has honed consummate horse archery and the art of command, not only successfully defending the wheat fields and pastures of Amprela, but also securing a prominent place on the political map of the Northern Empire. As one of Lucon's most capable archons, he uses his sharp tactical mind to claim ever greater authority for his house and the Northern Empire amid a chaotic landscape.
